target.description: Preferred: the ID (with or without '#') of the element to skip to. The component will normalize and add the leading '#'.

href.description: Full href for the skip link (overrides `target`/`skipTo`). Useful if you need to link to a different page or a non-anchor URL.

content.description: Text content for the skipnav link

children.description: Custom content for the skipnav link. If provided, this will override the `content` prop.

className.description: Additional classes to add to the skipnav link
